caller_script: How much is the maintenance plan?
reference_answer: The Comfort Club costs $189 a year per system or $16.99 a month (12-month minimum), $99 per additional system. It includes two seasonal tune-ups a year, priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived, 15% off repairs and no after-hours dispatch fee. Comfort Club Plus is $269 a year and adds a water heater flush and inspection, a plumbing inspection and 15% off plumbing repairs.
